title: Scheduler Prewindup Callback Wiring and Final Nonfeed Terminality

root_cause.issue: windup_guard() only called callback when should_enter_windup() was True
root_cause.fix: Always evaluate callback when provided, regardless of should_enter_windup() state

key_invariants: callback_supplied=True when callback provided, even when should_enter_windup=False
CT with raw=N accepted=0 is terminal (success_empty), not missing
